# HC TikZ Rules

- Each file must contain a complete `tikzpicture` environment with balanced braces.
- Use semantic node names and explicit edge directions.
- Keep labels concise; explanations belong in the caption.
- Never place an in-figure title. Use the paper caption instead.
- Compile a preview, run `tikz_check.sh`, then run `tikz_vision_check.py` on the rendered PNG.
